main_text.head: CLARISS. VIRI, CHRISTOPHORI Herdessiani, I.C. Inclytę Norimbergensis R.P. à Consiliis, verę Religionis Assertoris fortiss. & amici singularis, Memoriæ

p.i: Attamen, ecce, tua Beza am obmutescere morte,
Quidnam igitur nunc Beza tuum? quod scilicet illum
Nec tamè innumeras numeris coprendere laudes Conatur infanus tuas.
Innumeris Verùm lacrymis tua funera plangit, Innumera quæ trahunt mala.
Nam quæ te Pietas simul & Doctrina corona Ornauerat superstitem,
Quam Vereor tumulo obruerit Germania tecum, Herdessiane, quo iaces.

page.notes: The first word of the verse is a large initial "C" (Conari); the initial letter is partly obscured. Several words in the verse are doubtful, notably "Beza" forms and the abbreviation marks over "Nec", "Pietas" and "Quam". Underlining and marks in the scan are not text.
